observations: Black game console with a matte finish.
The console is shown in a closed state with its lid open.
The front of the console features the PlayStation logo in gold.
The rear of the console shows four circular ports and four directional buttons.
The console is sitting on a wooden surface in front of an abstract painting.
Watermarks for 'WILCOX HARRY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all photos.

claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4

risks.risk: The console may have internal hardware damage or a broken disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully reading and playing a game disc.

risks.risk: The console may be a lower-spec model (e.g., PS4 Slim) rather than the Pro.
risks.proof: A photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
